title: Grade XI Physics – Unit 4: Rotational and Circular Motion — Full 80-MCQ Summative Practice
sourceDocument: NBF Grade XI Physics, Unit 4 pp.53–76; FBISE Physics HSSC-I Assessment Framework pp.3–4; Unit 4 SLO audit V38
sourceSection: Draft original 56 independent source-grounded practice MCQs, pending addition of six four-question scenarios
limitations: Source-adapted practice only, teacher scientific review and browser/print QC pending; not an official FBISE exam.
Only the 12 Unit 4 summative SLOs are included; B-11 is formative and B-12/B-13 are collision SLOs outside Unit 4.
No student results stored or Firestore grades written by this public practice.
